item: OSM daily update job: the Update button, the consent, one worker and the task-manager row (v0.6.0 B1, S06-01 S1 J1)
key_paths: src/osm/update_job.py; src/api/osm_lane.py; src/api/jobs.py; src/osm/apply.py; src/static/app-map.js; src/static/taskmanager.js; docs/SECURITY.md; tests/test_osm_update_job.py; tests/test_osm_update_client.py
summary: A cut country can now be brought forward from the page: a button under each country's figures goes through the one online consent (ensureOnline) and POSTs /api/osm/countries/{code}/update with consent:true, which the route also demands (400 without it, 409 under the kill switch, by name, never a job that starts and fails). One worker runs one country at a time; the others show as queued; the job is a task-manager row (kind osm-update, in Downloads) with files applied of files owed and one fixed sentence for how it ended (10 outcomes, x12), no rate, no ETA, no byte total, no bandwidth cap (invariant #20). The country's own position moves in the same transaction as its objects, so a restart resumes from the stored position with nothing persisted by the job. update_country gained source_for (the region is read from the cut's own extract name, never from the caller) and on_progress (a raising callback never ends a run). A rebaseline_needed outcome is shown as such and points at the existing extract download; automating that re-cut is J2. SECURITY.md Maps row names the new path. Not browser-verified.
